org.metaabm.commands
Class SetDimensionalAttributesCommand

java.lang.Object
  SetCommand
      org.metaabm.commands.SetDimensionalAttributesCommand

public class SetDimensionalAttributesCommand
extends SetCommand

Creates dimensional attributes for a given projection based on dimensions provided. For example, when setting dimensionality of 2, attributes for width and height will be created.
